title: US-1: Folder suggestion API endpoint
description:
POST /api/suggest-folder. Takes snippet name/text/keywords + existing folder list. Uses app Ollama settings (ai-settings-store). Returns top 3 folder suggestions with confidence. Graceful fallback if Ollama unavailable.

## Exit Condition

```bash
set -e

# Structural: API route exists
test -f src/app/api/suggest-folder/route.ts
grep -q "POST" src/app/api/suggest-folder/route.ts

# Structural: uses AI settings store
grep -qE "ollamaUrl|ollamaModel|ai-settings" src/app/api/suggest-folder/route.ts

# Structural: returns suggestions array
grep -qE "suggestions|confidence" src/app/api/suggest-folder/route.ts

# Build + type check
npx tsc --noEmit
pnpm build

# Runtime: endpoint responds (graceful fallback when Ollama down)
pnpm dev &
PID=$\!
sleep 5
STATUS=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/suggest-folder \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "{\"snippet\":{\"name\":\"test\",\"text\":\"hello\"},\"existingFolders\":[]}")
kill $PID
test "$STATUS" -eq 200 -o "$STATUS" -eq 503
```

title: US-4: Drag-Drop Folder Reordering
description:
Drag folder to reorder siblings. Drag into folder to nest (max 3 levels). Prevents circular nesting. Drop zone indicators (before/inside/after). Undo with Cmd+Z.

## Exit Condition

```bash
set -e

# Structural: folder reorder/move functions
grep -qE "reorderFolderSiblings|reorderFolder" src/lib/store.ts
grep -qE "moveFolder" src/lib/store.ts

# Structural: circular nesting guard
grep -qE "isDescendantOf|circular" src/lib/store.ts

# Structural: depth limit check
grep -qE "getFolderDepth|MAX_DEPTH|maxDepth" src/lib/store.ts

# Structural: drop zone position logic (before/inside/after)
grep -qE "before.*after.*inside|dropPosition|DropPosition" src/components/Sidebar.tsx

# Structural: undo for folder moves
grep -qE "MoveFolderAction|ReorderFoldersAction" src/lib/undo-store.ts

# Build + type check
npx tsc --noEmit
pnpm build

# Playwright: verify folder drag-drop reordering
npx playwright test tests/e2e/ep0-4-drag-drop-folders.spec.ts
```

### Playwright Test Requirements

The Playwright spec MUST verify:
1. **Reorder siblings** — drag folder to before/after position, verify new DOM order
2. **Drop zone indicators** — top 25% = blue line above, bottom 25% = blue line below, middle 50% = blue ring (nesting)
3. **Nest folder** — drop in middle zone moves folder inside target, verify parent-child in DOM
4. **Max depth prevention** — dragging folder (with children) into deep folder shows red ring, move rejected
5. **Circular prevention** — dragging parent into its own descendant shows red ring, move rejected
6. **Undo (Cmd+Z)** — folder returns to previous parent and position

Note: Drop zone detection uses mouse Y position relative to target element. Playwright tests must position mouse precisely within the top/middle/bottom zones.
acceptance_criteria:
## Gherkin Scenarios

```gherkin
Feature: Drag-Drop Folder Reordering

  Background:
    Given the app is loaded at localhost:3000
    And root folders exist in order: "Alpha", "Beta", "Gamma"

  Scenario: Reorder folder among siblings
    When I drag "Gamma" above "Alpha" (to the top 25% drop zone of "Alpha")
    Then the folder order becomes: "Gamma", "Alpha", "Beta"
    And the reorder persists in the store

  Scenario: Drop zone indicator — before
    When I drag "Gamma" to the top 25% of "Alpha"
    Then a blue line appears above "Alpha" indicating "before" position

  Scenario: Drop zone indicator — after
    When I drag "Alpha" to the bottom 25% of "Gamma"
    Then a blue line appears below "Gamma" indicating "after" position

  Scenario: Drop zone indicator — inside (nesting)
    When I drag "Beta" to the middle 50% of "Alpha"
    Then "Alpha" shows a blue ring indicating "inside" nesting
    When I drop
    Then "Beta" becomes a child of "Alpha"

  Scenario: Nest folder into another (respecting max 3 levels)
    Given "Alpha" is at root (level 0)
    And "Beta" is at root (level 0)
    When I drag "Beta" into "Alpha"
    Then "Beta" becomes a subfolder of "Alpha" (level 1)

  Scenario: Prevent nesting beyond max depth
    Given folders: Root(0) > Child(1) > Grandchild(2)
    When I drag "Alpha" (which has a child "Sub") into "Grandchild"
    Then the drop target shows invalid indicator (ring-red-500)
    And the nesting is prevented because total depth would exceed 3

  Scenario: Prevent circular nesting
    Given "Alpha" contains subfolder "Beta"
    When I drag "Alpha" into "Beta"
    Then the drop target shows invalid indicator
    And the move is rejected (cannot nest parent inside its own descendant)

  Scenario: Undo folder move with Cmd+Z
    Given "Beta" was just moved inside "Alpha"
    When I press Cmd+Z
    Then "Beta" returns to root level in its previous position
```
